'''Djal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] who worked as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and held the title of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. At one point during the war, Djal was working on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], where he taught others about smuggling. He had [[Color/Legends|black]] hair, blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and green skin.
